videos.title: What's really at stake in the Jensen Huang saga | The Vergecast
videos.description:
Jensen Huang is no longer the CEO of Nvidia, but his problems — and the company's — are far from over. David and Nilay talk through what all this attention might do to Megaspeed, to Nvidia, and to the US / China AI race. Then they discuss a bunch of streaming news, as Hollywood tries desperately to compete with TikTok and Instagram. Finally, it's time for Brendan Carr is a Dummy, some meat smoking news, and the latest in how we measure things online.

videos.title: Apple HomeView review
videos.description:
Apple’s HomeView smart display is the centerpiece of its new push into the home. There’s plenty to like, but some drawbacks. It’s a fantastic controller for the smart home, a great speaker, and it brings Siri AI into the home for the first time. But it’s also an extension of your iPhone, giving you access to your texts, calendars, and reminders on a communal device. Would you even check your text messages in front of your parents?
